title: CLAIM: J.P. Morgan created the Federal Reserve
summary: Morgan died March 31, 1913 — before the Federal Reserve Act (Dec 23, 1913). Bankers including Paul Warburg influenced the design (Jekyll Island, 1910), but the Fed is a creature of Congress.
tldr: JPMorganChase's own history says the Federal Reserve was established in 1913 'shortly after Morgan's death' — he was dead before the central bank existed.
ai_summary:
AI review of JPMorganChase's official history page, read in full:
- States that after Pierpont Morgan's death in 1913, his son J.P. Morgan Jr ('Jack') took over as senior partner of the firm.
- States: 'in 1913, shortly after Morgan's death, the US established its much-needed central bank, the Federal Reserve.'
- This supports the record summary's core: Morgan died before the Fed's creation, so he could not have personally 'created' it.
- Note: the page gives no exact dates (no March 31, 1913 death date; no December 23, 1913 Federal Reserve Act date) and does not mention Jekyll Island (1910) or Paul Warburg — those details are outside the text reviewed.
- Record summary verified accurate in substance against the document.
